UnitStatement: This document is the active roadmap for planned work in the Chirality project execution system.
`TASK` is the canonical Type 2 shell for new bounded workflows.
Profiles should stay small and rare.
`DELIVERABLE_TASK` remains the main compatibility profile.
Any additional profile must justify shell-level behavior rather than method prose.
Recurring bounded execution methods should be expressed as repo-native skills with the four canonical skill documents.
Validation, normalization, reporting, and repeatable transforms should be implemented as deterministic helpers under `tools/`.
Human-facing orchestration stays in Type 1 personas.
Type 1 agents own workflow composition, scope selection, batching, consolidation, and gate-controlled human interaction.
The existing `ORCHESTRATOR` pipeline is grandfathered.
The working `ORCHESTRATOR` path and its retained subordinate task-family agents remain valid while the rest of the Type 2 layer is rationalized.
This document tracks the architectural direction at a high level.
Implementation details are governed through issue, branch, and release records rather than private planning folders.
Type 2 rationalization toward `TASK` plus skills plus tools is an active roadmap theme.
Audit workflow normalization is an active roadmap theme.
Evaluation workflow normalization is an active roadmap theme.
TOOL_POLICY Tier 1 structural validator hardening is ready on the roadmap.
Drawing-extract architecture and tool hardening is an active roadmap theme.
Hypergraph regression-hardening fixtures are an active roadmap theme.
DOMAIN knowledge indexing follow-on is an active roadmap theme.
Frontend normalization of matrix and pipeline selectors to the canonical post-wrapper architecture remains an unsplit backlog item.
R11 tool-contract enforcement beyond current TOOL_POLICY coverage remains an unsplit backlog item.
Content-hash enforcement for `_REFERENCES.md` remains an unsplit backlog item.
Deliverable-level lock semantics for concurrent task execution remains an unsplit backlog item.
Staleness-propagation tooling over dependency edges and baseline SHAs remains an unsplit backlog item.
Bounded methods outside the grandfathered `ORCHESTRATOR` pipeline should be moved into `TASK` skills to reduce remnant standalone Type 2 agents.
Deterministic validation should expand for skill tool-policy structure and R11/R12 tool-contract enforcement.
Audit execution should migrate out of standalone Type 2 agents into `TASK` skills.
A human-facing audit manager should be retained only where interaction gates require it.
`EVALUATION` should be preserved as a Type 1 manager while evaluation specialists migrate into `TASK` skills.
The drawing-extract pipeline should remain target-aware.
Drawing-extract should use deterministic tool contracts for per-page stubs, crop preparation, assembly, and validation.
Drawing-extract tools should be hardened around schema stability, path conventions, and reproducible validation fixtures.
DOMAIN knowledge indexing follow-on work is a focused engineering follow-on.
Hypergraph regression-hardening fixtures are a focused engineering follow-on.
KTY/object-ledger support fixtures for dependency and aggregation edge cases are focused engineering follow-ons.
Completed migration slices, hardening notes, and pre-refactor roadmap narratives are historical records rather than the active roadmap surface.
